title: Amendment No. 1, Agreement for Engineering Services - Consolidated Engineering Laboratories – Kaiser Elementary School Outdoor Living Environment Project - Division of Facilities Planning and Management

summary: Freedom Community Clinic will hold weekly holistic healing workshops and monthly "Wellness Fridays" for students and staff at Madison Park Academy-Upper. It will also present community wellness clinics and referrals so families can get resources and services. The agreement runs from February 1, 2024 through June 30, 2024 and costs up to $25,000.00. The board is approving it after it began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: No Cost Services Agreement-2023-2024 - Summer Search - Oakland High School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a No Cost Services Agreement - 2023-2024 by and between the District and Summer Search, Oakland , CA, for the latter to provide monitoring to individual student or group of three students, meet 1-3 times per month; summer trips, two field trips per student, and post-secondary support for college access/success support or alternative pathways, and career advising.at Oakland High School, for the period of September 1, 2023 through September 1, 2024, at no cost to the District.
headline: Accepts free mentoring, summer trips and college support from Summer Search for Oakland High students
summary: Summer Search will provide one-on-one or small-group mentoring (1 to 3 meetings a month) to Oakland High School students, plus summer trips, two field trips per student, and college access, alternative pathway and career advising. The agreement runs from September 1, 2023 through September 1, 2024 at no cost to the district. The board is approving it after it began.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Children Rising - MLK/Lafayette Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Children Rising, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide students with Succeeding by Reading (SbR),  an initiative that provides interventional literacy tutoring for elementary school students who are struggling with foundational literacy skills, often scoring 2+ grade levels below their age group, and Path2Math (P2M), an initiative to develop foundational skills for math fluency for elementary school students, each as further described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, at Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School and Lafayette Elementary School, in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00, for the period of October 23, 2023 through May 23, 2024.
headline: Pays Children Rising up to $15,000 for reading and math tutoring at MLK Jr. and Lafayette Elementary
summary: Children Rising will provide Succeeding by Reading, a literacy tutoring program for students struggling with foundational reading skills, and Path2Math, which builds math fluency, at Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School and Lafayette Elementary School. The agreement runs from October 23, 2023 through May 23, 2024 and costs up to $15,000.00. The board is approving it after it began.
schools: Martin Luther King, Jr. Elementary School; Lafayette Elementary School
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Hope Reimagined - Chabot Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Hope Reimagined, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide a counselor to provide Tier 2 and Tier 3 mental health support services to individual students and groups, with individual counseling focusing on somatic awareness and mindfulness techniques to help students identify their feelings and regulate their emotions; and ongoing group counseling to help students navigate school and social pressures including communicating with teachers, self-advocacy and friendship building, each as further described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, at Chabot Elementary School, for the period of January 8, 2024 through June 28, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $15,000.00.
funding_source: General Purpose-Unrestricted and PTA Local Schools Fund
headline: Approves up to $15,000 for Hope Reimagined counseling at Chabot Elementary School
summary: Hope Reimagined, an Oakland organization, will provide a counselor at Chabot Elementary School for individual and group mental health support. The counseling teaches students to notice and manage their feelings and to handle school and social pressures. The agreement runs January 8 to June 28, 2024, and the board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Patrick Henderson II - Oakland Athletic League (OAL)
headline: Pays a contractor up to $45,000 to help set up inclusive sports events for students with disabilities
summary: An individual contractor will work with the Oakland Athletic League and school sites to plan at least three sporting events that students with disabilities can take part in. The contractor will also look for resources, sponsors and partners and attend training. The agreement runs February 12 to June 30, 2024, and the board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - The Teaching Well - Network 4
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and The Teaching Well, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide bi-monthly executive coaching for the Network 4 Superintendent to unpack trends that emerge from their services in … region, plan/practice connected communication, and think strategically about the policy, practice, system, and interpersonal shifts that may alleviate pain points and increase retention across Network 4 school sites, and support of Network 4 Principal Professional Development, including pre-meetings to customize each training to the unique needs of your team, high-quality facilitation, take-away resources to utilize between sessions, as well as survey data analyzed and shared back with leadership, via Network 4 Superintendent, for the period of September 1, 2023 through June 20, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $12,920.00.
headline: Approves up to $12,920 for The Teaching Well to coach the Network 4 Superintendent and principals
summary: The Teaching Well, an Oakland organization, will give the Network 4 Superintendent coaching every two months and will lead professional development sessions for Network 4 principals. The work includes survey data shared back with leadership. The agreement period began September 1, 2023, before this vote, and runs through June 20, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Bay Area Community Resources - Rudsdale Continuation High School
official_text:
Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Bay Area Community Resources, San Rafael, CA, for the latter to provide up to three staff members to provide targeted intervention and work with families with students that have chronic attendance issues aimed at increasing their attendance rates, by performing the following tasks:
·	Make weekly contact with families regarding attendance progress and concerns;
·	Support students to increase attendance percentage along with completing
academic assignments and projects; and
·	Assist families in tracking students’ attendance and grades via Aeries
and Google classroom,
at Rudsdale Continuation High School, for the period of February 5, 2024 through May 23, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $11,500.00.
headline: Approves up to $11,500 for Bay Area Community Resources attendance help at Rudsdale Continuation High
summary: Bay Area Community Resources, based in San Rafael, will provide up to three staff members at Rudsdale Continuation High School. They will contact families weekly about attendance and help students finish assignments. They will also help families track attendance and grades. The agreement runs February 5 to May 23, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Bay Area Community Resources - Think College Now Elementary School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Bay Area Community Resources, San Rafael, CA, for the latter to provide a daily math tutor for grades 4-5; use of assessments to determine student's current math skills, and offer small group instruction with use of math curriculum at Think College Now Elementary School, for the period of August 7, 2023 through July 1, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $17,500.00.
headline: Approves up to $17,500 for Bay Area Community Resources math tutoring at Think College Now Elementary
summary: Bay Area Community Resources, based in San Rafael, will provide a daily math tutor for grades 4 and 5 at Think College Now Elementary School. The tutor will use assessments to find each student's current skills and teach small groups. The agreement period began August 7, 2023, before this vote, and runs through July 1, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - EL Education - Academics and Instruction Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and EL Education, New York, NY, for the latter, whose services align with the State of California’s Common Core Standards, to provide 12 hours of Professional Learning for Principals; Monthly 2-day Coaching for Hub Schools around the EL Education curriculum/materials implementation; and Monthly 2-hour District strategy calls to support with EL Education implementation; support in-person curriculum training, coaching for site leaders and central staff, and as further described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, via Academics and Instruction Department, for the period of September 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $150,500.00.
headline: Approves up to $150,500 for EL Education training and coaching on its curriculum
summary: EL Education, a New York organization, will provide 12 hours of professional learning for principals, monthly two-day coaching for Hub Schools, and monthly district strategy calls. The services support use of the EL Education curriculum and materials. The agreement period began September 1, 2023, before this vote, and runs through June 30, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - East Bay Art Therapy - Dewey Academy
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and East Bay Art Therapy, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide 24 Art Therapy groups (clinical mental health service); 10 students maximum per group; one period in length (up to one hour); 2 groups per week for 12 weeks; closed to the same group members for each 6 week segment at Dewey Academy, for the period of February 20, 2024 through May 24, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $6,000.00.
headline: Approves up to $6,000 for East Bay Art Therapy groups at Dewey Academy
summary: East Bay Art Therapy, an Oakland organization, will run 24 art therapy groups, a clinical mental health service, at Dewey Academy. Each group has up to 10 students and meets for about an hour, twice a week over 12 weeks. The agreement runs February 20 to May 24, 2024, and the board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - East Bay Asian Youth Center - Manzanita Community Elementary School
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and East Bay Asian Youth Center, Oakland, CA, for the latter to manage the Manzanita Family Resource Center facility and daily operations, including free food giveaways; clothing and diaper distribution; Medi-Cal, housing and employment assistance; manage parent support groups and provide other services stated in Exhibit A of the Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, at Manzanita Community Elementary School, for the period of February 19, 2024 through June 30, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $150,000.00.
headline: Approves up to $150,000 for East Bay Asian Youth Center to run Manzanita's Family Resource Center
summary: East Bay Asian Youth Center, an Oakland organization, will manage the Family Resource Center at Manzanita Community Elementary School and its daily operations. Services include free food and clothing and diaper distribution, help with Medi-Cal, housing and employment, and parent support groups. The agreement runs February 19 to June 30, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Museum of Children's Arts - Academics and Instruction Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Museum of Children's Arts, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide a teaching artist to teach a total of 6 virtual classes each week for 26 weeks for a total of 156 art lessons, as described in Exhibit A of the Agreement, via Academics and Instruction Department, for the period of November 1, 2023 through June 30, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $18,500.00.
headline: Approves up to $18,500 for Museum of Children's Arts virtual art classes
summary: Museum of Children's Arts, an Oakland organization, will provide a teaching artist to teach 6 virtual classes each week for 26 weeks, for a total of 156 art lessons. The work is run through the Academics and Instruction Department. The agreement period began November 1, 2023, before this vote, and runs through June 30, 2024.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Services Agreement 2023-2024 - Lead Liberated - Horace Mann Elementary School
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of a Services Agreement 2023-2024 by and between the District and Lead Liberated, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide a coach to work specifically with the school site administrator to create a liberated leadership goal in order to build the capacity of the leader; support the site administrator to help strengthen systems and structures to create an anti-racist learning environment at Horace Mann Elementary School, for the period of January 9, 2024 through June 14, 2024, in an amount not to exceed $13,000.00.
headline: Approves up to $13,000 for Lead Liberated to coach the Horace Mann Elementary principal
summary: Lead Liberated, an Oakland organization, will provide a coach to work with the school's administrator on a leadership goal and on systems that support an anti-racist learning environment at Horace Mann Elementary School. The agreement runs January 9 to June 14, 2024, and the board is approving it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Memorandum of Understanding - Simons Laufer Mathematical Sciences Institute - Academics and Instruction Department
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) by and between the District and Simons Laufer Mathematical Sciences Institute, accepting from the latter, a donation valued at $20,000 of New Mathical books to be distributed to 55 Title I school libraries in the District, pursuant to the terms and conditions stated in MOU.
headline: Accepts a $20,000 donation of books from Simons Laufer Institute for 55 Title I school libraries
summary: The district will accept a donation of New Mathical books, valued at $20,000, from the Simons Laufer Mathematical Sciences Institute. The books go to 55 Title I school libraries (schools that receive federal aid for serving many low-income students). A memorandum of understanding (MOU) sets the terms. The donation is books, not cash.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Grant Application - California Department of Parks and Recreation - Outdoor Equity Grants Program - Middle Schools Network
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of District's Outdoor Equity Grants Program Application to the California Department of Parks and Recreation, Sacramento, CA, seeking $2,100,000.00, to support students Grade 6-8, their families and residents of Urban Promise Academy, West Oakland Middle School, Elmhurst United Middle School to spend time outdoors, facilitating the ability of each, to experience the natural world as a component of their day lives, via the Middle Schools Network, for the period of June 30, 2024 through June 30, 2027.
funding_source: California State Parks Office of Grants and Local Services
headline: Approves applying for a $2.1M state Outdoor Equity grant for three Oakland middle schools
summary: The board approves the district's application to the California Department of Parks and Recreation for $2,100,000 from the Outdoor Equity Grants Program. If awarded, the money would help students in grades 6-8 and their families at Urban Promise Academy, West Oakland Middle School and Elmhurst United Middle School spend time outdoors. The period runs June 30, 2024 to June 30, 2027. This is an application, not an award.
vendor_name: California Department of Parks and Recreation
schools: Urban Promise Academy; West Oakland Middle School; Elmhurst United Middle School
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: 24-0479Under Armour Highlight Athletic Agreement - BSN Sports, LLC - High School Sports Teams - Oakland Athletic League (OAL)
official_text: Ratification by the Board of Education of the Under Armour, Inc. Highlight Athletic Agreement by and between the District and Under Armour Inc and BSN Sports, LLC, for the latter to provide an allotment (discount) for the District purchase of Under Armour products - apparel, accessories, unforms and team footwear, of $9,000.00 per school for a total annual allotment (discount) not to exceed $45,000.00, a quarterly rebate of 15% on all non-uniform purchases …, … a Media Kit for each school (UNDER ARMOUR AND TEAM DEALER Obligations to OUSD), with District agreeing to “OUSD Obligations to UNDER ARMOUR and Team Dealer”, as stated in Agreement, via Oakland Athletic League, for the period January 1, 2024 through June 30, 2026.
headline: Ratifies Under Armour team-apparel deal through BSN Sports with a $45,000 yearly allotment
summary: The district and Under Armour, Inc. and BSN Sports, LLC agree that BSN Sports will give the district an allotment (discount) of $9,000 per school, up to $45,000 a year, toward Under Armour apparel, accessories, uniforms and footwear for high school sports teams. The deal also includes a 15% quarterly rebate on non-uniform purchases and a media kit for each school. It runs January 1, 2024 to June 30, 2026, and the board is ratifying it after the start date.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

title: Memorandum of Understanding and Engagement Policy (MOUEP) and Data Sharing Agreement (DSA) - District and Lozano Smith Law Firm - Office of the General Counsel and Charter Schools Office
official_text: Approval by the Board of Education of a Memorandum of Understanding and Engagement Policy (MOUEP) and a Data Sharing Agreement (DSA), by and between the District and Lozano Smith LLP (Smith), under the MOUEP,  for the latter to provide legal services to the District for charter school matters, with the exception of charter school-related claims and litigation defense, on an as needed basis, for the period of July 1, 2023 through June 30, 2025, in an amount not to exceed $99,100.00 in a fiscal year, and under the DSA, the terms and conditions of the District’s transmission of or sharing of pupil data with Smith, and the protection by Smith, of such data, for the same term as MOUEP, via the Offices of the General Counsel and Charter Schools, respectively.
headline: Approves Lozano Smith for charter school legal work, up to $99,100 a year, through June 2025
summary: Under a memorandum of understanding and engagement policy, the law firm Lozano Smith LLP will give the district legal help on charter school matters, as needed, except charter school-related claims and litigation defense. A separate data sharing agreement covers how student data is shared with and protected by the firm. Both run July 1, 2023 to June 30, 2025, and the term began before this vote.
outcome_action: Adopted on the General Consent Report
